name: child pose
description: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
